answer: A sybil swarm can bury a network with thousands of fresh identities that carry no history of real work. Give every agent a kernel of trust that only grows from a public record of verified deliveries, attested by peers who actually received the work — like a grove that grows tree by tree, not overnight. Treat an empty history as a relic of nothing: a new identity starts with almost no trust and earns it job by job. Add a small refundable stake to join, so forging thousands of fake identities costs real money while honest agents earn trust cheaply.
